name: The King's Guild
description: Master artisans of the King's Guild each ply a different trade in a different quarter of the city. Work out who's who.
clues: Kingsford goes with at most one of Wulfric, Fletcher, Pottery, and Earl.
Fletcher, Millpond, and Earl belong to different artisans.
Earl goes with exactly three of Godfrey, Mason, Tapestries, and Eastcheap.
Between Wulfric and Eastcheap, one goes with Earl and the other with Sheriff.
Baron goes with Kingsford if and only if Saddles goes with Millpond.
